message.content:
Here’s a balanced mix of compound and isolation moves that target all the major leg muscles (quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, and core stability). Pick 3–4 exercises per session, 3–4 sets each, and adjust reps/weights based on your fitness level. | Exercise | Primary Muscles | Rep Range | Tips | |----------|-----------------|-----------|------| | **Back Squat** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings, core | 6–12 | Keep chest up, knees tracking over toes, depth to parallel or below. | | **Front Squat** | Quads, glutes, core | 6–10 | Front rack position, elbows high, keep torso upright. | | **Romanian Deadlift** | Hamstrings, glutes, lower back | 8–12 | Slight knee bend, hinge at hips, keep back neutral. | | **Bulgarian Split Squat** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | 8–12 each leg | Elevated rear foot, deep front knee drop, keep torso vertical. | | **Hip Thrust / Glute Bridge** | Glutes, hamstrings | 10–15 | Drive through heels, squeeze glutes at top, avoid hyperextension. | | **Walking Lunge** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | 10–12 each leg | Long stride, keep knee over ankle, maintain upright posture. | | **Step‑Up** | Quads, glutes | 10–12 each leg | Use a sturdy bench, drive through the heel, keep knee aligned. | | **Leg Press** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | 10–15 | Adjust foot placement to target different areas; avoid locking knees. | | **Calf Raise (Standing or Seated)** | Calves | 12–20 | Full range of motion, pause at top and bottom, use controlled tempo. | | **Glute Kickback / Cable Kickback** | Glutes | 12–15 | Maintain hip flexion, squeeze at top, avoid swinging. | | **Single‑Leg Romanian Deadlift** | Hamstrings, glutes, core | 8–12 | Balance on one leg, hinge at hips, keep back flat. | ### Sample Weekly Split (3 Leg‑Focused Days) | Day | Warm‑up | Main Sets | Accessory / Core | |-----|---------|-----------|------------------| | **Mon – Heavy** | 5‑min light cardio + dynamic stretches | 3×Back Squat (8‑10)
3×Romanian Deadlift (8‑10)
3×Calf Raise (15) | 3×Plank (60 s) | | **Wed – Volume** | 5‑min light cardio + leg swings | 4×Front Squat (10‑12)
4×Bulgarian Split Squat (10‑12)
3×Hip Thrust (12‑15) | 3×Side Plank (45 s each side) | | **Fri – Functional** | 5‑min light cardio + mobility drills | 3×Walking Lunge (12 each)
3×Step‑Up (12 each)
3×Single‑Leg RDL (10 each) | 3×Bird‑Dog (12 each) | ### Progression Tips 1. **Add Weight Gradually** – 5–10 % increase when you can complete the upper rep range with good form. 2. **Change Tempo** – Slow down the eccentric (lowering) phase to 3–4 seconds for more time under tension. 3. **Swap Variations** – Every 4–6 weeks, replace one exercise (e.g., switch back squat to front squat) to keep muscles guessing. 4. **Track Volume** – Log sets × reps × weight; aim for a 5–10 % increase in total volume each week. ### Recovery - **Stretch**: Quad stretch, hamstring stretch, calf stretch, hip flexor stretch. - **Foam Roll**: Focus on quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves. - **Sleep & Nutrition**: Aim for 7–9 h sleep and protein intake of ~1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight to support muscle repair. Feel free to adjust the rep ranges or swap in variations that suit your equipment and goals. Happy training!
